Tiada perjudian bermakna tiada kerugian—tiada orang yang membunuh diri akibat kerugian besar, dan tiada orang yang terjebak dengan dadah kerana tekanan hutang yang melampau. Tetapi walaupun anda tidak berjudi, kewujudan kasino akan terus melahirkan lebih ramai penjudi. Dan para penjudi itu, bersama sindiket seperti ah long, akan mengganggu keharmonian masyarakat dan negara.

title: Key Details of the Drop • The Cash Call: Genting announced a renounceable rights issue to raise approximately RM1.25 bil
author: Share Traders
body: Key Details of the Drop • The Cash Call: Genting announced a renounceable rights issue to raise approximately RM1.25 billionto help pare down its total borrowings (which stood at RM47.5 billion as of June 2026) and fund general working capital. • Use of Proceeds: About RM800 million (64%) is earmarked for debt repayment within 12 months, and RM429.5 million is allocated for operational needs. • Pricing & Dilution Concerns: The issue price is planned at a 25% to 30% discount to the theoretical ex-rights price (TERP). Research houses like CIMB Securities estimate that the rights issue could dilute earnings per share (EPS) by up to 18% for financial years 2027 and 2028. • Market Reaction: The heavy sell-off wiped out over RM1 billion from the group's market capitalization within the first morning of trading, and subsidiary Genting Malaysia Bhd also saw downward pressure. ————— Comment mplus to open your cds account and share this share traders page.

title: PETALING JAYA: Genting Bhd’s offer to privatise Genting Malaysia Bhd at RM2.35 per share is deemed unfair but reasonable
author: StarBiz | Business & Economy
body: PETALING JAYA: Genting Bhd’s offer to privatise Genting Malaysia Bhd at RM2.35 per share is deemed unfair but reasonable, according to an analyst. Tradeview Capital Sdn Bhd portfolio manager Ng Tzyy Loon said the RM2.35 offer price— representing a 9.8% premium over Genting Malaysia’s last traded price of RM2.14—may be deemed unfair for investors who have held the stock for years at higher prices of RM3 to RM5. “However, investors may still take the offer because they have no choice. If they do not accept it, they probably would not be able to recover their money,” he told StarBiz. In a filing with the local bourse yesterday, Genting Bhd announced its plans to buy out and delist Genting Malaysia in a deal worth RM6.7bil. The offer to minority shareholders is equivalent to RM2.35 per share. Trading in shares of Genting Malaysia and Genting Bhd was suspended on Monday. Ng said he was “surprised” by Genting Bhd’s decision to proceed with the takeover deal, noting that the move came even though Genting Malaysia’s share price was already trading above its net tangible asset (NTA) value of RM2.10 per share. “Looking at the company’s book value, it did not seem worthwhile to privatise unless it was cheaply discounted. However, if you look at the company as a whole, its intrinsic value has been declining day by day — so whether they do it now or later, there is not much difference,” he said. Ng said it remains to be seen how many shareholders will accept the offer in the first round and how quickly they do so, looking at the current premium. “Shareholders can wait until the last minute before deciding whether to accept, as things may still develop,” he said. “If acceptances are low, Genting Bhd may sweeten the offer, by raising the offer price by about 5% to around RM2.50. Hence, those hoping for a better deal may choose to delay in accepting the deal,” he added. Ng said the downside of the takeover deal for Genting Bhd is quite limited and mainly lies in the cash outlay. Instead, operationally, the group may benefit from reduced investor scrutiny as a result of the exercise. Genting Bhd said the privatisation deal will mostly be satisfied through debt financing of up to RM6.3bil, while the rest will be settled through internally generated funds. Following the exercise, the gearing level of the company is expected to reach 0.50 times from 0.43 times, while the total debt will increase to RM46.7bil from RM40.4bil. Currently, Genting Bhd holds RM20.9bil of cash. Genting Bhd currently holds 49.36% of Genting Malaysia and the offer is expected to allow Genting Bhd to gain statutory control of Genting Malaysia, to cement Genting Bhd’s position as the holding company of Genting Malaysia and to become its majority shareholder. Moreover, Genting Bhd also rationalises the exercise as a move that would strengthen its financial position and flexibility, allowing it to support Genting Malaysia’s expansion plans, including its US$5.5bil bid to develop a new integrated resort in New York through its subsidiary, Genting New York LLC. Ng said Genting Bhd likely had little choice but to finance the deal through borrowings, as it may not have sufficient internal funds or may prefer not to commit too much of its own capital. “The whole privatisation is largely financed by debt, which means they can raise funds through debt issuance or bank borrowings. “This shows that Genting Bhd is relying more on the debt market rather than the equity market, and it probably indicates that the group is not in urgent need of equity funding compared to other listed companies,” he said. Meanwhile, Rakuten Trade head of equity sales Vincent Lau said the privatisation exercise is a good move for Genting Bhd as it allows the group to streamline its operations and regain tighter control of its core assets. Lau said the deal also enables Genting Bhd to take advantage of Genting Malaysia’s depressed share price, which is near its 52-week low. #starbiz

title: Genting Bhd’s latest bond issue signals possible challenges for future dividends. While it may have lost some appeal as
author: StarBiz | Business & Economy
body: Genting Bhd’s latest bond issue signals possible challenges for future dividends. While it may have lost some appeal as a dividend play among equity investors, its core businesses remain resilient – one reason it continues to have access to funding. Genting raised US$1.5bil through two tranches of unsecured subordinated perpetual bonds, despite the threat of a credit rating downgrade. The PerpNC5.5 (perpetual non-call 5.5-year bond) and PerpNC10 (perpetual non-call 20-year bond) tranches carry coupon rates of 7.65% and 8.3%, respectively, and were oversubscribed by more than 2.2 times. Proceeds will be used to refinance US$1.5bil of senior bonds due in January 2027. The high yields reflect the risk of the group losing its investment-grade rating as it navigates a heavy capital expenditure (capex) cycle, which could exceed RM8bil annually through financial year 2030 (FY30). Much of the capex will go towards expanding its gaming projects in Singapore and New York, as well as servicing debt incurred from acquiring shares in subsidiary Genting Malaysia Bhd last year. Free cash flow is expected to remain negative until at least FY28, according to reports. Hence, the new perpetual bonds are “covenant-lite, with features such as coupon step-ups (25 basis points if not called at the 10-year mark) and resets every five years after the first call date. Rising capex and debt obligations mean future dividends payout could remain depressed unless earnings recover at its Las Vegas and Singapore businesses. A Credit Sights report notes that while the bonds permit coupon deferrals, these are subject to “dividend stoppers”, meaning Genting cannot pay dividends if bondholders are not paid. The group’s liquidity, however, remains strong, with consolidated cash currently outstripping short-term debt, supporting its ability to raise fresh funding. #starbiz

title: PETALING JAYA: Genting Bhd’s core net profit (CNP) is expected to see a rise in the financial year 2026 (FY26) and FY27,
author: StarBiz | Business & Economy
body: PETALING JAYA: Genting Bhd’s core net profit (CNP) is expected to see a rise in the financial year 2026 (FY26) and FY27, supported by CNP recovery from Genting Singapore and Genting Malaysia’s (GenM) New York operations. However, analysts have cut their target price after factoring in Resorts World Las Vegas’ (RWLV) net debt. GenM’s 4Q25 CNP turned around year-on-year (y-o-y) to RM114mil but fell 31% quarter-on-quarter (q-o-q), mainly on lower earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortisation (ebitda) from Resorts World Genting (lower VIP gross gaming revenue, high employee costs) and Resorts World New York City (RWNYC) which is in transition to new casino licence. “We expect GenM’s CNP to fall slightly by 2% y-o-y in FY26, largely dragged by higher interest cost on debt raised by RWNYC to pay for the upfront commercial casino licence fee and capital expenditure for the initial phase,” CIMB Research said in a report yesterday. An analyst, who spoke on the condition of anonymity, told StarBiz that despite the recent earnings volatility, Genting’s diversified portfolio across Malaysia, Singapore and the United States provided multiple recovery levers. The key would be execution and balance sheet discipline going forward, the analyst said. “The group’s prospects hinge largely on the ramp-up in RWNYC and a sustained recovery in Singapore. “While RWLV remains a drag, we see gradual improvement across its core assets supporting earnings growth ahead,” he said. Genting Singapore’s 4Q25 CNP fell 57% y-o-y to S$62mil, as gaming revenue fell 13% y-o-y on lower win rate, while casino receivables impairment was also higher. This was partly buffered by a 13% y-o-y rebound in non-gaming revenue driven by newly refreshed attractions and hospitality offerings. “We project Genting Singapore’s FY26 CNP to recover by 28% y-o-y, assuming normalisation in the gaming win rate and continued non-gaming revenue growth,” CIMB Research said. The research house expected Genting Plantation’s CNP to decline 13% y-o-y in FY26, mainly on lower crude palm oil (CPO) prices (reflecting the RM200 per tonne cut to its 2026 CPO price assumption to RM4,000 per tonne). Genting Plantation’s 4Q25 CNP fell 11% y-o-y to RM119mil due to lower fresh fruit bunch production (down 5% y-o-y), lower CPO prices (down 11.5% y-o-y to RM3,746 per tonne), and weaker associate contributions. Meanwhile, CIMB Research said recovery at RWLV continued to be very slow with its 4Q25 ebitda increasing by 23% quarter-on-quarter to US$15mil on seasonally higher revenue and better margin of 7.9%. However, in the overall scheme of things, the research house said this is “still far away from the average quarterly ebitda of US$47mil and margin of 21.2% between the fourth quarter of 2022 (4Q22) and 2Q24”. The research house projected RWLV’s net loss to narrow by 6% y-o-y in FY26, with gradual improvement expected only over the next few years. It trimmed it CNP forecast for Genting by 3% for FY26 but raised it by 14% for FY27 as Genting’s higher 73.8% stake in GenM (up from 49.3% before the mandatory takeover offer) gave it greater exposure to the RWNYC-driven jump in GenM’s FY27 CNP. “Post earnings forecast revisions, we project Genting’s CNP to rebound by 243% y-o-y in FY26, mainly underpinned by Genting Singapore. “We then expect CNP to rise by a further 33% y-o-y in FY27, led by GenM (RWNYC) and Genting Plantation (higher output),” it said. Moreover, CIMB Research has cut its sum-of-parts-based target price for Genting by 23% to RM3.05, mainly due to the inclusion of RWLV’s net debt. “We had previously excluded this as RWLV’s debt is non-recourse. “However, our observation is that the market does not distinguish RWLV’s debt from group debt, and we also believe that if RWLV were to get into financial difficulties, Genting will step in to inject fresh capital,” the research house said. #starbiz

title: 虽然公司 2026 财年第二季（2Q26） 业绩预计将面对压力，但分析员认为，这只是短期挑战。 📌 为什么第二季表现可能较弱？ 🔸 中东战争影响云顶世界云顶（RWG）及英国业务（GENUK）表现。 🔸 2026 年 FIFA 世界杯分散博彩
author: Listen to LEE
body: 虽然公司 2026 财年第二季（2Q26） 业绩预计将面对压力，但分析员认为，这只是短期挑战。 📌 为什么第二季表现可能较弱？ 🔸 中东战争影响云顶世界云顶（RWG）及英国业务（GENUK）表现。 🔸 2026 年 FIFA 世界杯分散博彩娱乐消费，影响赌场收入。 因此，分析员将： 📉 2026 财年盈利预测下调 28% ⚠️ 并认为 2Q26 核心净利润存在转亏风险。 📈 为什么仍然看好长期？ 尽管短期承压，但长期增长动力依然存在： ✅ 纽约云顶世界（RWNYC）赌桌业务持续强劲增长 ✅ 老虎机税率下调，有助提升盈利能力 ✅ 持续扩充营运容量，支持未来收入增长 因此，分析员仅将 2027 与 2028 财年盈利预测下调 4%，认为目前的不利因素属于暂时性。 对于长期投资者而言，市场更关注的是未来几年的盈利能力与成长潜力。如果世界杯效应消退、国际旅游持续复苏，加上纽约业务持续增长，云顶马来西亚未来仍具备进一步提升盈利的机会。 💬 你认为云顶马来西亚（4715）目前值得逢低布局吗？ 欢迎留言分享你的看法！ 📌 关注《Listen to Lee 听李说股事》 每天一分钟，掌握最新财经资讯，发掘投资机会！ #invest #investment #genting #4715 #tiktok

title: Genting Berhad dan Genting Malaysia Berhad mungkin akan disingkarkan daripada menjadi sebahagian daripada komponen saham
author: CTC.FM NEWS
body: Genting Berhad dan Genting Malaysia Berhad mungkin akan disingkarkan daripada menjadi sebahagian daripada komponen saham yang membentuk indeks saham tempatan, KLCI. Kuala Lumpur Composite Index yang mengumpulkan 30 saham syarikat tempatan dengan prestasi terbaik itu akan melakukan pengumuman kemas kini mereka pada Khamis hadapan. Rabu lalu, Genting Berhad menduduki tangga ke-35 manakala Genting Malaysia Berhad di tangga ke-38 berdasarkan 'market capitalisation'. Ini kerana baru-baru ini saham kedua-dua syarikat ini telah mencecah harga terendah mereka sejak Januari 2021. Tahun ini sahaja, Genting dan Genting Malaysia telah mengalami penurunan lebih dari 20%. Dibawah 'FTSE Bursa Malaysia Index Series', satu-satu saham syarikat akan dikeluarkan daripada indeks KLCI jika kedudukan 'market capitalisation' mereka jatuh ke tangga 36 ataupun lebih rendah dari itu. Tambahan lagi, saham syarikat yang sama boleh dimasukkan semula jika mereka berjaya meraih semula kedudukan ke tangga 25 atau lebih tinggi. #economyexpress #news #berita #genting #klci #saham #bursa #stock

body: 一般这种情况最大可能就是股权结构变化。有可能是转移总公司结构。比如马来西亚云顶变成新加坡云顶。意思就是说公司总权利和利益转到新加坡，操作方法就是新加坡云顶收购马来西亚云顶。说句不好听就是有放弃马来西亚云顶经营的准备。或许有一天我们会听到马来西亚云顶纯粹变成了游乐场不再有赌场。被迫把公司卖给马西西亚马来人公司。就像当年的郭鹤年。

author: OhMyBursa
body: 斥资55亿美元打造的纽约赌场，云顶大马原本指望它成为新的摇钱树。 第二季营收大涨32%至RM38.5亿，净利润却暴跌89%，只剩RM4740万。 算上汇兑损失和高企营运成本，上半年净利润暴跌91%。 美国业务营收暴增120.9%，规模已直逼大马本土季度营收。 营收数字看着亮眼，利润表却越算越难看，这场纽约豪赌的代价，才刚刚开始显现。 #云顶大马 #GentingMalaysia #纽约赌场 #财报暴跌 #马来西亚股市

author: OhMyBursa
body: 上个星期五的一张公告，让云顶 Genting 在星期一开市不到30分钟就蒸发了RM10亿市值。 供股集资RM12.5亿，当中RM8亿拿去还短期债务，听起来挺合理。 可是股价直接暴跌17%跌到RM1.56，创下1998年以来最大单日跌幅，也是2007年4月以来的最低价。 跌幅触发limit down，Bursa当天暂停这只股的卖空交易，子公司GENM也跟着跌8%。 Genting总负债高达RM453亿，8月才刚公布季度亏损，9月又被Fitch降级到BBB-。 CIMB证券一句话定调：没有人喜欢供股。不过也有分析师认为，信贷被降级后借钱越来越贵，供股或许才是现在唯一走得通的路。 #云顶 #Genting #供股 #跌停 #马来西亚股市

author: 阿狗
body: 关于“谁获得了云顶集团30%的土著股份”这一提问，在马来西亚商业史和法律法规中需要区分国家整体政策配额与公司实际股权结构： 1. 马来西亚“30%土著股权”政策背景 马来西亚自1971年推行新经济政策（NEP）起，规定在当地上市或特定行业发展的公司，需将至少30%的股权分配/分配给土著（Bumiputera）机构或投资者。云顶集团（Genting Berhad）作为马股上市公司，其股权结构同样需要符合国家宏观调控的要求。 2. 谁持有这些土著股份？ 在实际操作中，云顶集团的土著股权并非由单一家族或个人“全额获得”，而是通过以下几类机构与个人投资者共同持有： • 国家级土著基金与机构投资者：马来西亚政府为落实土著经济赋权，设立了多家信托基金与机构。在公开市场和配售中，持有云顶集团及旗下子公司（如云顶大马）股份的主要土著机构包括： o 国民投资机构（PNB / Permodalan Nasional Berhad）： 马来西亚最大的土著资产管理机构。 o 雇员公积金局（EPF / Kumpulan Wang Simpanan Pekerja）： 虽然为全民养老金，但在其庞大的投资组合中包含大量土著受益份额。 o 朝圣基金局（Lembaga Tabung Haji） 及 武装部队基金局（LTAT） 等其他官方土著信托机构。 • 土著个人与私人企业投资者： 部分经由原国内贸易及消费人事务部（或后来的经济部）核准的土著商业伙伴及散户投资者，通过公开二级市场或特定私下配售持有股份。 3. 云顶集团的实际控制权 需要明确的是，30%的土著股权属于国家经济政策下的股权分布比例，而云顶集团的实际控制权和最大股东始终是创办人林梧桐家族： • 林氏家族主要通过私人投资公司——建发实业私人有限公司（Kien Huat Realty Sdn Bhd） 持有云顶集团的控股权。 • 目前云顶集团由林梧桐之子丹斯里林国泰及其家族管理与决策。 根据不同时期公开资料及市场记录，涉及大型上市公司土著持股的机构通常包括： • Permodalan Nasional Berhad (PNB) • Amanah Saham Nasional (ASN) • Amanah Saham Bumiputera (ASB) • 州投资机构 • 政府相关基金

author: Boss
body: 你敢信吗？云顶林家，马来西亚最有钱的华人家族之一，现在自己人打起来了，林梧桐的孙辈，把叔伯告上法庭，争的是云顶的控制权，另一边，林梧桐女儿林秀琼那十六亿令吉的遗产案，也闹得不可开交，一个靠赌场起家、靠云顶称霸的家族，如今为了钱，撕破了脸，这出大戏，比云顶的赌局还刺激。 你可能不知道，这场官司的主角是谁，林梧桐，云顶集团创办人，已故，他的孙辈，林定鸿，林定豪，林淑玲，把叔伯林国泰，林启华告了，他们主张自己有权继承父亲那一份云顶的股权，可叔伯那边，显然不这么想，一个家族的股权，卡在两代人中间，谁也不让。 你想想，这摊子有多乱，林秀琼，林梧桐的女儿，留下的遗产超过十六亿令吉，可她生前改了遗嘱，把两个女儿的继承，从各自一千万令吉，砍到九十万和十万，一个砍成零头，另一个几乎是清零，女儿不服，打官司，连遗嘱律师都出来作证，说林秀琼生前觉得女儿不配拿更多，这个家族，钱多，恩怨更多。 更扎心的是，这背后是云顶的盘子，云顶，不只是赌场，是马来西亚数得上的商业帝国，酒店，度假村，游乐场，博彩，谁拿下家族股权，谁就握住云顶的方向，这场官司，打的表面是继承，底下是云顶的控制权，叔伯赢，孙辈只能看，孙辈赢，云顶的天就要变。 看多了你就明白，富豪家族的钱，是最好赚的，也是最烫手的，林梧桐打下的江山，本想让家人过得更好，可他一走，家人为这江山打得不可开交，豪门内斗，争的从来不是钱本身，是钱背后的权，这场官司的结局，会写成马来西亚家族企业最贵的一课。 这场官司，最后会怎么判，云顶的控制权会不会易主，林秀琼那两个女儿，能不能讨回公道，关注我，我盯着法庭的每一场庭审，一有宣判第一时间跟你说。 #财经 #fyp

author: YOKO
body: 告诉你个大瓜，马来西亚顶级华人家族云顶林家，现在自家内部彻底闹翻了。林梧桐的孙辈直接把林国泰告上法庭，硬刚争夺云顶集团的控制权。另一边，林梧桐女儿林秀琼那笔 16 亿令吉的遗产官司，同样吵得不可开交。 说实话，这出豪门大戏，比云顶赌场里任何一局赌局都要刺激。 整件事源头，就是云顶创办人林梧桐。现在是他的孙辈林定红、林定豪、林舒林，集体起诉林国泰。孙辈这边的诉求很明确，他们认为理应继承父亲名下那部分云顶股权，但林国泰并不认可这个说法。两代人死死咬住股权不放，僵局很难解开。 同一时间还有林秀琼的巨额遗产案，金额高达 16 亿令吉。她生前修改遗嘱，原本留给两个女儿各一千万令吉，直接砍到只剩 90 万和 10 万。几乎等于大幅缩减继承份额，两个女儿当然不服，直接对簿公堂。就连拟定遗嘱的律师都出庭作证，说林秀琼生前认为女儿不配拿到更多遗产。 这个家族坐拥巨额财富，但埋藏的恩怨更深。别忘了，云顶可不单单只有赌场，它是大马重量级商业帝国，度假村、酒店、乐园加上博彩业务盘根错节。这场官司表面争的是遗产和股份，本质抢的是云顶未来的话语权。 如果林国泰胜诉，孙辈基本很难插手集团事务。可一旦孙辈胜诉，整个云顶的格局都会大变。看多这种豪门纷争你就懂，富豪的财富看着诱人，其实也是最烫手的。林梧桐辛辛苦苦打下这片江山，初衷本是庇护家人，可他离世之后，亲人却为这份基业互相打官司。豪门争斗，争的从来不是钱本身，而是财富背后的权力。 这场庭审的判决，将会成为马来西亚家族企业最昂贵的一堂课。最后法院会怎么判？云顶控制权会不会易手？林秀琼的两个女儿能不能争取到想要的结果？我会持续跟进每一次庭审，一旦宣判马上来更新。点好关注，不要错过后续进展。 #财经 #fyp

title: In a bourse filing, the group said it is proposing to privatise Genting Malaysia via the acquisition of 2.87 billion sha
author: Share Traders
body: In a bourse filing, the group said it is proposing to privatise Genting Malaysia via the acquisition of 2.87 billion shares or 50.64% equity in the subsidiary for a total consideration of RM6.74bil. It will finance the purchase with RM6.3bil in debt financing and internally generated funds. The offer is conditional upon Genting receiving enough acceptances from shareholders to push its holding in Genting Malaysia past the 50% equity threshold. As at the last practicable date prior to the announcement, Genting held 49.36% stake in the company. Upon the offer becoming unconditional, Genting is obliged to accept all valid acceptances received on or before the closing date. Genting said it does not intend to maintain the listing status of Genting Malaysia, and will apply to Bursa Securities to withdraw its listing status should it hold in aggregate 90% or more of Genting Malaysia shares. It will also seek to delist Genting Malaysia should the acceptances received result in the company not meeting the public shareholding spread requirement of 25%. Source:thestar

title: KUALA LUMPUR (Nov 3): Genting Bhd said its takeover offer for Genting Malaysia Bhd has become unconditional after the gr
author: Share Traders
body: KUALA LUMPUR (Nov 3): Genting Bhd said its takeover offer for Genting Malaysia Bhd has become unconditional after the group surpassed the 50% ownership threshold on Monday (Nov 3). According to a statement issued by Genting's principal adviser AmInvestment Bank, the group now owns 2.84 billion GENM shares — representing 50.105% of GENM’s total issued shares (excluding treasury shares) — following open market acquisitions. Genting, which held 49.999% of GENM shares prior to the posting of the offer document, acquired an additional six million shares to cross the threshold. The offer, announced on Oct 13, is priced at RM2.35 per share — a nearly 10% premium to GENM’s last traded price of RM2.14 on Oct 10 before the stock was suspended for the announcement. Genting has stated that it does not intend to maintain GENM’s listing status. If successful, the privatisation would mark the exit of a company that has been listed on Bursa Malaysia for nearly four decades. With the acceptance condition now met, the offer will remain open until Nov 24, unless extended or revised, said AmInvestment Bank. Source:theedge
